mechanism_narrative: A sustained quarterly expansion in real GDP (GDPC1) signals robust economic growth, increasing corporate earnings visibility and driving positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days through elevated profit expectations.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day forward returns are negative in more than 55% of periods when GDPC1 growth is positive (t-test p-value > 0.05 for positive returns vs. baseline).

mechanism_narrative: When the federal funds rate exceeds 5.0%, it indicates aggressive monetary tightening that compresses equity valuations through higher discount rates, causing negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 5-day forward returns are positive in more than 55% of instances when FEDFUNDS > 5.0% (t-test p-value > 0.05 for negative returns vs. baseline).

mechanism_narrative: A simultaneous decline in manufacturing employment (PAYEMS) and industrial production (INDPRO) signals labor market deterioration and supply chain stress, triggering negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days through reduced corporate capacity utilization.
failure_condition: The joint decline in PAYEMS and INDPRO does not produce negative 60-day returns in more than 55% of cases (t-test p-value > 0.05 for negative returns vs. baseline).

mechanism_narrative: In a monetary tightening cycle (FEDFUNDS > 5.0% and rising for 2 months), policy-induced liquidity contraction reduces risk appetite and increases cost of capital, driving negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day forward returns are positive in more than 55% of periods when FEDFUNDS > 5.0% and rising for 2 months (t-test p-value > 0.05 for negative returns vs. baseline).

mechanism_narrative: A declining unemployment rate (UNRATE) indicates tightening labor market conditions that boost consumer spending and corporate profit margins, driving positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day forward returns are negative in more than 55% of periods when UNRATE is declining (t-test p-value > 0.05 for positive returns vs. baseline).

mechanism_narrative: When housing starts (HOUST) fall below 1500 thousand units, it reflects weakening residential investment and reduced household wealth, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days through diminished consumer confidence.
failure_condition: SPX 5-day forward returns are positive in more than 55% of instances when HOUST < 1500 (t-test p-value > 0.05 for negative returns vs. baseline).

mechanism_narrative: A simultaneous rise in inflation (CPIAUCSL) and federal funds rate (FEDFUNDS) indicates aggressive policy response to inflation, increasing real interest rates and reducing equity valuations, causing negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: The joint rise in CPIAUCSL and FEDFUNDS does not produce negative 60-day returns in more than 55% of cases (t-test p-value > 0.05 for negative returns vs. baseline).

mechanism_narrative: In an early-cycle expansion (INDPRO growth above 1.0% year-over-year), accelerating manufacturing activity boosts corporate earnings visibility, driving positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days through improved economic momentum.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day forward returns are negative in more than 55% of periods when INDPRO YoY growth > 1.0% (t-test p-value > 0.05 for positive returns vs. baseline).
